decision.title: XPath and XQuery conformance sweep: "//" paths, place static contexts, XML 1.1 query text (packet )
decision.summary: Absolute "//" paths map only their first step over the descendants, comparisons use the default collation of their module, library modules keep their static context, and reads_query_text_as_xml_1_1 adds XML 1.1 query text.

body.p: , after , , , , , . One public header changed additively (processor.h, below); one IR field (sxml_ir_binary.module_number) and one IR global flag (sxml_ir_global_variable.is_external).

item.p: Start (release drivers, whole runs at 87686bc): XP40 32,793 passed (30 wrong-error), 40 failed; XQ40 46,070 (49), 138 failed; XT40 12,207, 311 failed. Most XQ40 failures are 's kept groups (whitespace-only assert-xml, among them fn-analyze-string's and the six upd-propagateNamespace cases; recordTypeDecl/ paths; EXPath Binary's types; staticTyping).

"//E1/E2" (XPath 4.0, 4.6.3; the orchestrator's priority, found by 4.26): an absolute "//" path lowered its whole relative path as one MAP body per descendant, so later steps ran once per descendant and atomic results repeated (//PRICE/../../name()). The first step of the relative path is now mapped over the descendants and each later "/" or "//" is a chain link (chain_locals.start_operand), as in a relative path; 's descendant pass still applies.

XSLT globals in inline functions (XSLT 4.0, 9.7, a variable in scope in its own declaration): read from the unit's global table at call time, as XQuery's (); XPath's host-bound globals stay captured (). A function item called after its evaluation ended still reads no global table ('s limit, now XSLT's too).

The default collation of a place (XSLT 4.0, 3.7.1): comparisons carry the module of their static context (sxml_ir_binary. module_number, as static calls do, ) and compare strings under its default collation; the filter-index pass leaves such comparisons alone. 's open item (choose-0107, collations-0121 to -0124).

A library module's static context (XQuery 4.0, 5.2): its IR module records its decimal formats, default collation, in-scope schemas and statically known namespaces; its functions read them when they run (format-number with the library's decimal format; validate in a loaded module's function).

fn:load-xquery-module (F&O 4.0, 18.2): the variables option binds external variables only; vendor-options is map(xs:QName, item()*) (XPTY0004); content loaded without trust gets no module or schema imports (FOQM0003). The QT4 driver serves an undeclared module from the suite file its location hint names.

Context-dependent references (XPath 4.0, 4.5.4; F&O 4.0, 1.7): a named reference to a native row with USES_DYNAMIC_CONTEXT is a closure of its module, so it keeps its static context and trust when another module calls it. fn:function-lookup's run-time results are not covered (xqhof18, xqhof19).

xml:id under lax validation (xml:id 1.0, 4): without a declaration in scope, xml:id is assessed as xs:ID (is-id, the ID table, IDREFs to it). 's open item. IDREF checks at an element validation root stay as XSD's cvc-id has them (no text of XQuery 4.0, 4.25, which defines validate by fn:xsd-validator, lifts them); the two upd- cases expecting otherwise stay failing.

XML 1.1 query text (; 's design taken by ): sxml_processor_configuration.reads_query_text_as_xml_1_1 (include/sxml/processor.h, additive; glossary query_text_xml_version), false by default: NEL and LINE SEPARATOR are line ends (a pre-pass translates them in a copy; error offsets after one are in the copy), character references may denote C0 controls, xmlns:p="" undeclares p in a direct constructor, and an undeclared output:version is 1.1. The QT4 driver sets it for a test that depends on xml-version 1.1 alone; the CLI does not.

omit-xml-declaration (deviation from 's design): made the library's XQuery default no while the CLI writes none, which the CLI cannot tell apart from a declared no without a new function. The library keeps DEFAULT (yes) for an undeclared parameter; the QT4 driver, as a host, takes no (XQuery 4.0, 5.22.1 leaves it to the implementation).

Measured (release drivers, whole runs, case by case, no case lost at any step): XP40 32,793 to 32,797 passed (40 to 36 failed); XQ40 46,070 to 46,101 (138 to 107 failed, 49 to 44 wrong-error); XT40 12,207 to 12,220 from this packet's changes (12,239 in the final run, with 4.26's and 4.27's commits); XSD11 41,486 unchanged. CONFORMANCE.md is not regenerated: 4.28 commits XSLT changes while these runs were made, so no one commit matches them.

Not done: Q{}N name tests on JNodes (frozen sxml_name_test); runtime constructors of named item types for fn:function-lookup (itemTypeDecl-058); function items fn:function-lookup makes (xqhof18, -19); format-number's decimal format name with a direct constructor's namespaces (eqname-007); two modules of one namespace without a location (modules-collide-var-001, -fn-001); the serialization singletons (adaptive 6, csv 1); deep-equal of partial applications (4); fn:transform 3; static typing (: not done).
